openpbr.conformance: authored against the OpenPBR parameter set and rendered through a shader that is OpenPBR-aligned but not conformance-exact; Blender 5.3.0 Alpha has no OpenPBR node and no MaterialX operators, and upstream issue #145127 records exact import/export as wanted rather than delivered

not_mapped.base_weight: the shader has a single base layer and no layer stack
not_mapped.coat_roughness: the shader has coat roughness, but not independently of the coat's own defaults
not_mapped.fuzz_weight: not used by an opaque icon
not_mapped.specular_weight: the shader's 'Specular IOR Level' is an artist scale, not a linear weight on F0
not_mapped.subsurface_weight: not used by an opaque icon
not_mapped.thin_film_ior: not implemented by the target shader
not_mapped.thin_film_thickness: not implemented by the target shader
not_mapped.transmission_weight: not used by an opaque icon; deliberately unpinned rather than approximated

camera.why: an icon is a symbol; perspective would foreshorten the parts nearest the camera

rig.denoising: off; a denoiser is a post-process and would have to be declared
rig.downsample: box average in linear light over exact integer factors (192->48 averages 16 px, 192->32 averages 36, 192->24 averages 64)

fill.role: lifts the shadow side without flattening the form

key.role: the light the shading model is checked against

rim.role: separates the silhouette from the surface behind it

rig.view_transform: Standard (no filmic or AgX transform, so the saved pixels encode radiance)
rig.world: black; the three lights above are the only illumination

why_committed: cargo build must never need Blender; the renders are artifacts with provenance, and this script is how they were produced
